# p01_三角形四心 — 中考·三角形四心：内心/外心/重心/垂心
# 注：GeoGebra 没有 Incenter/Circumcenter/Orthocenter 命令，
# 内心 = Center(Incircle(...))，外心 = Center(Circle(A,B,C))，
# 垂心 = 两条高的交点。
A = (0, 0)
B = (6, 0)
C = (2, 5)
tri = Polygon(A, B, C)
inc = Incircle(A, B, C)
I = Center(inc)
circ = Circle(A, B, C)
O = Center(circ)
G = Centroid(tri)
mAB = Midpoint(A, B)
mAC = Midpoint(A, C)
altC = Line(C, mAB)
altB = Line(B, mAC)
H = Intersect(altC, altB)
